$comment: Vendorized snapshot of the open Agent Skills standard frontmatter contract, from agentskills.io/specification, snapshot dated 2025-12-18, re-verified against the published spec and the skills-ref reference validator on 2026-07-08. This schema is the EXTERNAL conformance check only: it encodes what the Agent Skills spec allows at the top level of a SKILL.md frontmatter block, plus two documented runtime extension fields (disable-model-invocation, argument-hint) that Claude Code reads from the top level — a deliberate, recorded deviation from strict skills-ref (which rejects unknown fields), decided in spec 0016 cl-7 because relocating them would break runtime behaviour (e.g. disable-model-invocation guards deploy skills). The spec prose says metadata values are strings; the reference validator does not enforce value types, and aiadev deliberately nests an object under metadata.aiadev (spec 0016 cl-1/cl-7). Do not add aiadev-internal fields here; those live in schemas/skill-frontmatter.schema.json under metadata.aiadev. Directory-name matching for `name` is enforced by code, not by this schema.
title: Agent Skills Standard Frontmatter
description: Conformance schema for the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io) SKILL.md frontmatter contract, with documented Claude Code runtime extensions.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case skill identifier, 1-64 chars. Must equal the containing skill directory name (checked by tooling, not by this schema).

description.description: Non-empty summary used by agents to decide when to invoke the skill.

license.description: Optional license identifier or attribution string.

compatibility.description: Optional 1-500 char string describing environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access).

metadata.description: Optional map for additional metadata not defined by the spec. The spec prose recommends string values and reasonably unique key names; the reference validator does not enforce value types, and aiadev nests its pipeline fields under the single namespaced key `aiadev` (validated by schemas/skill-frontmatter.schema.json).

allowed-tools.description: Experimental: pre-approved tools the skill may use. The standard documents a space-separated string; a comma-separated string is tolerated (existing catalog usage).

disable-model-invocation.description: Runtime extension (Claude Code): when true, only the user can invoke the skill. Kept at top level because the runtime reads it there; see $comment.

argument-hint.description: Runtime extension (Claude Code): hint shown for slash-command arguments. Kept at top level because the runtime reads it there; see $comment.
